stories.title: French ambassador to CAR faces investigation over alleged misconduct
stories.summary: Inquiry follows security concerns over reported visits of dozens of women to Bruno Foucher’s official residence France has opened disciplinary proceedings against its ambassador to Central African Republic over allegations of misconduct, after claims that he brought dozens of women into his official residence, raising potential security concerns. The investigation comes as Paris seeks to rebuild relations with CAR, after their sharp deterioration in recent years amid Russia’s expanding influence in the former French colony. stories.headline: French ambassador to CAR faces investigation over alleged misconduct

opening: Inquiry follows security concerns over reported visits of dozens of women to Bruno Foucher’s official residence France has opened disciplinary proceedings against its ambassador to Central African Republic over allegations of misconduct, after claims that he brought dozens of women into his official residence, raising potential security concerns.
The investigation comes as Paris seeks to rebuild relations with CAR, after their sharp deterioration in recent years amid Russia’s expanding influence in the former French colony.
